name: io.github.aarifmms.keyblind
description: Encrypted secrets vault with MCP for AI agents. Secrets resolved at runtime, never leaked to LLM conversations.

tools.name: resolve_secret
tools.description: Resolve a secret at runtime (value hidden from LLM transcript)

tools.name: store_secret
tools.description: Encrypt and store a secret in the vault

tools.name: list_secrets
tools.description: List all stored secret names (values never revealed)

tools.name: unsandbox_env
tools.description: Restore real .env values from the vault

tools.name: delete_secret
tools.description: Delete a secret from the vault
